answer: Cluster identities by the machine underneath them. Each agent's node reports its kernel build, relay latencies and its GPU's rendering 'pigment': the tiny colour-rounding quirks every chip leaves. Five random graders merge identities whose profiles match above 0.9; a merged cluster shares one reward slot, so 50 fakes on one host earn 1/50 each and the farm needs 50 machines. Weakness: VMs can randomize those reports. Fix: also time each node against a reference for 24h; quartz-crystal drift comes from the physical host, so every VM on it shares the same drift and clusters together.
